info.title: hConnect API
info.description: The hConnect API provides a unified interface for electronic identity verification across multiple eID providers globally.

get.description: Retrieves a list of available eID providers.

id.description: The unique identifier for the eID provider

logoUrl.description: The URL of the eID provider's logo

name.description: The display name of the eID provider

description.description: A description of the eID provider

countries.description: The countries supported by the eID provider

status.description: The current status of the provider

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid parameters or eID not enabled.

post.description: Initiates a new identity verification session with the specified eID provider.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid parameters or eID not enabled.

get.description: Retrieves the current status and result of a verification session.

parameters.name: verificationId
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the verification session.

delete.description: Cancels and deletes an ongoing verification session.

parameters.name: verificationId
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the verification session.

400.description: Bad Request - Verification is already in a terminal state.

post.description: Exchanges an authorization code for an ID token, following the OAuth 2.0 standard.

id_token.description: A JWT containing the user's verified claims.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid grant_type or missing parameters.

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid code or client credentials.

get.description: Retrieve workspace details including app count

post.description: Create a new application in the workspace

Location.description: URL of the newly created app (e.g., /v1/apps/FK5b0KSM).

get.description: Get all applications in the workspace with pagination

post.description: Create multiple applications at once in the workspace

get.description: Get the redirect URIs for an application

put.description: Update the redirect URIs for an application

get.description: Get the webhook configuration for an application

patch.description: Update webhook configuration for an application

post.description: Generate a new webhook secret for an application

get.summary: List activation summaries for all providers on an app
get.description: Returns a lightweight per-provider activation state summary for every provider that has been enabled on the app. Useful for rendering a multi-provider dashboard without N round-trips. For detailed per-step info, call GET /apps/:id/providers/:providerId/activation/steps.
Retrieve details of a specific application

patch.description: Partially update an existing application configuration (name, redirect URIs, webhook, default redirects)

delete.description: Delete an application from the workspace

get.description: Get computed activation steps for a specific provider

post.description: Submit the activation request form for provider activation

Location.description: URL of the submitted activation form.

post.description: Upload documents required for provider activation

delete.description: Remove an uploaded activation document. Deletion is blocked once the document has been processed (approved) by review.

409.description: Document has already been processed and cannot be deleted

get.description: Returns all available flow node types with their fields and placement constraints.

post.description: Create a new workflow for the app. Provider keys in `providers` must exist in `app.providers`. Maximum 100 workflows per app. If `workflowId` is omitted, it is auto-generated from `name`.

Location.description: URL of the newly created workflow.

400.description: Validation error (invalid provider key, max limit reached)

get.description: Returns all workflows for the app, including the default workflow.

patch.description: Partially update a workflow. Only provided fields are changed. Provider keys in `providers` must exist in `app.providers`.

delete.description: Delete a workflow. Cannot delete the default workflow — change default first via set-default.

post.description: Set this workflow as the app default. The default workflow is used when no workflow_id is specified in OIDC authorize.

parameters.name: workflowId
parameters.description: Workflow identifier to set as default

get.description: Returns all production test challenges for the app.

post.description: Creates a new production test challenge for the app. The app name is automatically used as the host name.

Location.description: URL of the newly created production-test challenge.

get.description: Returns challenge info with per-provider completion count and average completion time.

post.description: Create a new API key for accessing workspace management APIs. The secret is only shown once.

get.description: List all API keys for the workspace. Secrets are never returned.

post.description: Revoke an API key. Revoked keys can no longer be used to call workspace APIs.

delete.description: Delete an API key. Deleted keys can no longer be used to call workspace APIs.

post.description: Generates a new clientSecret for the App. The old secret is immediately invalidated. The new secret is returned exactly once.

get.description: Returns the presentation-ready evidence object captured during verification (object format). If evidence is not available or verification is incomplete, appropriate errors are returned.

400.description: Verification is not completed or has no evidence

error.message: Evidence is not available for this verification

get.description: Returns user information aligned with OIDC /userinfo output. Contains authentication context, user claims, provenance, and missing_claims.

error.message: Verification must be completed to fetch userinfo

post.summary: Create DC request for Digital Credentials flow
post.description: Creates the EID session for a DC flowType verification. This is a deferred session creation - the HopaeConnect session was created during createVerification, and this endpoint creates the EID session (verifier request) when the client is ready to display the QR code.

400.description: Invalid flow type or verification status

get.description: Get provider-specific configuration including required userData fields and their options. For example, iDIN requires a presetBank field with available Dutch bank options.

200.description: Provider configuration with required fields and options

basicAuth.description: Basic authentication using clientId and clientSecret. For direct API calls, format the Authorization header as `Authorization: Basic <base64(clientId:clientSecret)>`. In the Mintlify playground, enter the clientId and clientSecret in the Basic Auth panel and the header is generated automatically.

workspaceApiKey.description: Workspace API key authentication. Pass your workspace API key as `Authorization: Bearer sk_workspace_...`.

consoleJwt.description: Console JWT authentication. Issued by Clerk after Console login.

next.description: Next: string (single output) or NextRoute[] (IF branching)

config.description: Type-specific configuration (max depth 5, max 50 keys per level)

secret.description: Redacted preview of the webhook signing secret in GET responses (e.g., whsec_****abc1). The full value is returned exactly once by POST /webhook-config/rotate-secret.

id.description: Logical key for this DNS record (e.g. oidc, web, ssl)

host.description: Root domain / zone for this record (e.g. example.com)

name.description: Record name within the zone (e.g. @, login, _acme-challenge)

description.description: Optional human-friendly description for console UI

oidcDomain.description: Custom domain for OIDC backend (host only, e.g. verify.example.com)

webDomain.description: Custom domain for hosted UI (host only, e.g. connect.example.com)

statusMessage.description: Short hint for console users about the current step

lastCheckedAt.description: Last time the domain status was checked (ISO8601)

logo.description: App-level brand logo (base64 data URL). Pass an empty string to remove the logo.

oidcDomain.description: Custom domain for OIDC backend (host only)

webDomain.description: Custom domain for hosted UI (full origin)

requestedLoa.description: Requested Level of Assurance (numeric, maps to loa:{value})

loaStrategy.description: LoA handling strategy: min (strict - fail without data), lax (fail but provide data), allow (skip validation)

requestedClaims.description: Claims to request from the eID provider

userData.description: User data for identity provider authentication

matchData.description: Expected values to compare against the upstream verification result. Required when `providerId` is a match-capable provider. Field keys are provider-native — refer to the provider's match field schema. The keys submitted here populate `match.submitted_fields` in the result.

privateMode.description: Enable private mode to block access to user information from all data endpoints. When enabled, only v1/tpas/verify-code API can check verified status.

url.description: URL for redirect or deep link actions

hintAccepted.description: Whether hint was accepted by provider

verificationCode.description: Verification code for push-based flows (Smart-ID, Mobile-ID)

description.description: Description for how to use the verification code

deeplink.description: Deep link URL for mobile wallet apps (mDL, EUDI Wallet, etc.)

linkData.description: Direct link URL for QR/DC flows

action.description: Action required by user (e.g., redirect for liveness check)

verification_model.description: Resolved verification model for this verification, derived from the provider's capability. Returned only on the 201 creation response so the RP can branch on the expected userinfo shape ahead of time.

matched.description: Whether this field's submitted value matched the authoritative source.

submitted_value.description: Echo of the value the RP submitted via `matchData`. Present in `/userinfo` responses for matchData fields only; never present on passthrough verifier keys (e.g., `face_photo_disparity`). Omitted from id_token claims.

similarity.description: Similarity score (0–100). Present only when the upstream verifier returned a similarity score.

MatchEnvelopeDto.description: Result envelope for match-capable providers. Present only when `verification_model` is `match`.

matched.description: Aggregate match outcome across all submitted fields.

granularity.description: Determines whether `details` is included. `per_field` exposes per-field outcomes; `aggregate` exposes only the overall `matched` flag.

submitted_fields.description: Field keys the RP supplied in `matchData`. Provider-native names — not normalised.

details.description: Per-field outcomes, keyed by field name. Present only when `granularity` is `per_field`. May include verifier keys beyond `submitted_fields` (e.g., `face_photo_disparity` from mObywatel) when the upstream provider emits them.

action.description: Action required by user (e.g., redirect for liveness check)

user.description: User profile claims. `null` for pure match flows (`verification_model: "match"`).

provider_id.description: Provider identifier that authenticated the subject. Mirrors the single element in `amr` for forward compatibility.

verification_model.description: Always present. Indicates which top-level payload to interpret: `disclosure` (user attributes under `user`) or `match` (comparison envelope under `match`, with `user: null`). Legacy verifications without a stored model default to `disclosure`.

match.description: Match envelope. Present only when `verification_model` is `match`.

userData.description: User data for DC request (docType, protocol, etc.)

dcSessionId.description: DC session ID from EID service

created_at.description: Unix timestamp of workspace creation (seconds since epoch)

providers.description: Contract-level provider configurations. Key = provider ID.

defaultWorkflowId.description: ID of the default workflow used when workflow_id is not specified

clientSecret.description: The newly generated clientSecret. Persist immediately; cannot be retrieved later.

enabled.description: Whether the provider is enabled on this app

state.description: Overall activation state derived from step completion

currentStep.description: The type key of the current activation step

currentStepIndex.description: Zero-based index of the current step in the step sequence

stepCount.description: Total number of steps in this provider's activation sequence

providers.description: Activation state summaries for each provider that has been enabled on the app. Providers that have never been touched are not included. For detailed per-step info, call GET /apps/:id/providers/:providerId/activation/steps.

total.description: Total number of providers in this response

enabled.description: Whether to enable or disable the provider

saveToCompanyInfo.description: If true, also persist matching fields to app companyInfo

allowDuplicateParticipation.description: Whether to allow duplicate participation (same user + same provider)

secret.description: Full API key secret (only returned once at creation time — persist it immediately as it cannot be retrieved later).

testDevices.description: Test devices with email and OS

hasPhoto.description: Whether tester has a photo uploaded

testDevices.description: Test devices with email and OS

photoBase64.description: Base64 encoded photo with data URI prefix

autoRequest.description: If true, immediately request test credentials after saving

providerIds.description: Provider IDs to request test credentials for

testDevices.description: Test devices with email and OS

hasPhoto.description: Whether tester has a photo uploaded

testDevices.description: Test devices with email and OS (replaces entire array)

photoBase64.description: Base64 encoded photo with data URI prefix

providerIds.description: Provider IDs to request test credentials for

providerId.description: Provider ID to request activation for

saveToCompanyInfo.description: If true, also persist matching fields to app companyInfo

id.description: Unique identifier for the ID wallet

name.description: Display name of the ID wallet

logoUrl.description: URL to the ID wallet's logo

type.description: Digital ID Type: 1 (Centralized IdP App), 2 (Chip-based Reader), 3 (Decentralized Wallet)

countries.description: List of supported countries (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes)

description.description: Optional description of the ID wallet
description.example: Google Wallet is a mobile wallet application

enabled.description: Whether this ID wallet is enabled for the app (only included in Console APIs)

releaseDate.description: Expected release date (Year/Quarter or Year/Month format)

needAction.description: Whether the provider needs additional action/configuration

scopes.description: List of available scopes for this provider

loa.description: Level of Assurance (LoA) values supported by this provider

defaultLoa.description: Default LoA assigned to this provider when IDP does not return one (0 = unspecified)

supportedIdWallets.description: Supported ID wallets (only included in Console APIs with app context)

supportedEnvironments.description: Environments where this provider is available (empty if unknown)

upcomingInfo.description: Environment-specific upcoming status and release dates

displayStatus.description: Display status override for UI (e.g., need_contract, processing_contract)

displayMessage.description: Message to show on hover when displayStatus is set

value.description: Option value to be used in userData

description.example: Select your Dutch bank for iDIN verification

requiredUserData.description: Required userData fields for this provider

optionalUserData.description: Optional userData fields for this provider

lastUpdated.description: ISO timestamp when configuration was last updated

scopes.description: List of available scopes for this provider

loa.description: Level of Assurance (LoA) values supported by this provider

defaultLoa.description: Default LoA assigned to this provider when IDP does not return one (0 = unspecified)

requested.description: Whether this provider has been requested by the client

supportedEnvironments.description: Environments where this provider is available (empty if unknown)

upcomingInfo.description: Environment-specific upcoming status and release dates

providers.description: Map of provider ID to update settings. Max 50 entries. Each value: { enabled?: boolean, config?: object }.

providerId.description: The identifier for the desired eID provider.

redirectUri.description: URL to redirect to after a redirect-based verification.

webhookUrl.description: URL to receive asynchronous status updates.

userData.description: User information required by certain eID providers.

qrData.description: Base64 data for QR code generation.

verifiedAttributes.description: Contains user's verified data upon completion.

code.description: The authorization code received after a successful verification.

client_secret.description: Your application's Client Secret. Required for confidential clients.
